castle_guide.text: Welcome to Kilkenny Castle. William Marshal, son-in-law of Strongbow, built the first stone one here in the 1190s, beside the Nore.
The Butler family owned it from 1391 until 1967. Then the last of them sold it to the people of Kilkenny for just 50 pounds.
Do see the Long Gallery, with its painted roof and portraits. The Butlers did like their faces on a wall.
